item.title: Pregnant woman killed after being struck by car while biking with family in Playa del Rey
item.description: A pregnant woman was struck and killed while riding her bike with her family. The crash happened around 6 p.m. Saturday, Jan. 31 near the intersection of Pershing Drive and Manchester Avenue in Playa del Rey. Regan Cole-Graham, 36, was riding with her husband and two children when she was hit by a vehicle.
